Implemented in /private/tmp/eyes4s-family-ui on work/family-ui, based on a29d6f5603f6067574ffe490eda6b697b8b6f3cc. Source commit 5342bf47cf4900b00a953e45dfded923ae4a4c0a; source tree a8608b10262e7ae2dac4012eb6efc5b79d789342. Reviewed final diff; no persisted schema, core or library API changes.

Navigator groups and desktop nodes use nominal AnalysisFamilyId, with registry names projected separately and duplicate names disambiguated. Shared AnalysisSelection resolves exact history and family breadcrumbs for preview, presets and configuration. Preset actions capture their revision, retain it across navigation, and cannot edit another held draft. New analysis creates an independent provisional family using Encoding/Retrieval defaults on latest admitted data. Current-run summary is scoped to the selected family; explicit Show retains the existing ready-notice guard. Added user documentation.

Validation completed using JDK 25, GITHUB_ACTIONS=true and default headless FX with FxRunLock retained: full studioAppJVM/test and studioAppJS/test each passed 648 tests (one existing ignored each); all 10 AnalysesNavigatorFxSuite tests passed; all 4 PreflightFxSuite tests passed. studioAppJS/fastLinkJS, studioStyleCheck, full checkBoundaries, and rootJVM/rootJS Test/compile with -Werror passed. git diff --check passed. Logs: target/family-ui/app-and-fx-2.log (app and preflight successes; also preserves initial overflow-fixture failure) and target/family-ui/fx-style-boundaries.log (corrected 10/10 navigator tests plus remaining checks).

Regression coverage includes equal names, registry rename focus retention, historical bases, captured action targeting, cross-family running/completed/draft activity, creation/edit/undo/redo, saved reopen, overflow keyboard visibility and explicit Show. Corrected overflow test coordinates to compare inside the ScrollPane viewport; no tolerance relaxation. Analysis breadcrumb snapshot intentionally changes from a preset label to the family name and identifier. Reviewed 1440x900 Analysis board snapshots for the existing history and duplicate-family states; layout remains legible with no overlap. Images under target/studio-snapshots/AnalysesNavigatorFxSuite.

Ready for review and landing qualification. Full landing gate, API audit/consumer and full Studio desktop suite have NOT been run for this slice. No push or main advance. Keep slice in review and parent S7.7 open until landed. Primary checkout remains on main; no shared Ivy publishing occurred. Following tracker commit only records this handoff and session lifecycle.
